facts.text: Compile defaults depth to index and raises DossierRequestException with code invalid_depth for any value other than index or full.
Compile defaults order to rank and raises invalid_order when order is neither rank nor seq.
Compile raises invalid_budget when the requested budget is negative and uses DefaultBudgetTokens when budget is omitted.
Compile raises invalid_recency unless rank.recency is between 0 and 1, defaulting it to DefaultRecencyWeight.
In complete mode Compile skips Dedupe, so every ranked candidate is emitted as its own entry, while strict mode clusters first.
When order is seq, Compile re-sorts the emitted facts by CreatedAt and then by the rank comparer after budget selection.
Compile sets UsedTokens to the sum of the fact, conflict and gap token estimates in the requested format.
For index depth Compile rewrites each view text through OneLine with IndexLineLength before budgeting.
In complete mode the budget is only the highlight threshold, because Compile emits every representative in rank order.
at: The budget is only the highlight threshold.

facts.text: Compile computes gaps with FindGaps over the emitted facts, not over every ranked candidate.
Compile finds conflicts from all candidates before any budget selection, so a dropped fact still contributes a conflict value.
When OmitStatusNotes is set Compile nulls each view's Why, which removes the status note from the rendered line.
Compile treats an omitted format as json.
Compile adds descendant subject ids only when request.Descendants is true.
Compile opens a ReadSnapshot before resolving the subject, so ranking reads one consistent store view.
RankOrder compares the stale flag first, then score descending, then key, kind, text and content_hash last, so random ids never reach the order.
In index depth SelectWithinBudget caps fact content at the smaller of budget and IndexTokenCap and takes the first IndexMinFacts facts regardless of cost.
SelectWithinBudget stops adding facts once IndexMaxFacts have been chosen.
After a current fact is left out for size, SelectWithinBudget skips every later stale fact.
In full depth SelectWithinBudget fills a greedy slice of 0.75 of the budget and skips any fact whose cost would exceed that slice.
Dedupe makes each not-yet-collapsed fact a representative and absorbs later facts whose token-set Jaccard similarity reaches DedupeThreshold.
Dedupe merges two facts only when both are stale or both are current, never one of each kind.
Facts whose TextTokens count is below DedupeMinTokens are never clustered by Dedupe.
LoadCandidates excludes facts whose status is superseded or retracted and any fact whose kind is dossier.
LoadCandidates derives each candidate's Inbound from the number of refs rows whose target is that fact id.
LoadCandidates reads facts ordered by key, kind, text, content_hash and id, fixing the input order before ranking.
at: ORDER BY f.key, f.kind, f.text, f.content_hash, f.id

facts.text: LoadCandidates defaults a candidate's Explicitness to 0.25 when no ref points at that fact.
ScoreCandidates computes relevance from bm25 over facts_fts with weight 10 for text and 3 for tags, clamped at zero and divided by the maximum.
ScoreCandidates sums 2.0 relevance, 1.0 centrality, 1.0 confidence, the recency weight times recency, and 0.5 explicitness into the score.
When every candidate shares one CreatedTime, ScoreCandidates gives each candidate a recency of 1.0.
ScoreCandidates queries facts_fts only when the needs yield at least one token; otherwise relevance stays zero.
ScoreCandidates sets centrality to the candidate's inbound count divided by the largest inbound count, or 0 when that largest count is 0.
FindConflicts only reads facts on the requested subject itself whose stored status is live.
FindConflicts reports a flattened field only when at least two distinct facts and two distinct raw values disagree.
Flatten gives each array item a path built from the parent path, a dot and its zero-based index.
FindConflicts skips a candidate whose data JSON root is not an object.
FindConflicts orders each conflict's values by the rank comparer over the facts that supplied them.
FindGaps adds a gap with reason no fact when no single selected fact holds all of a need's tokens across its text, tags and kind.
NeedTokens keeps only tokens of at least 3 characters that are not in Stopwords.
DescendantIds walks the subject tree breadth-first for at most MaxDescendantDepth levels below the root and skips ids already seen.
When several subjects match, ResolveCompileSubject prefers an exact id match over name and alias matches, and otherwise takes the first ordinally sorted id.
at: An exact id match wins over name/alias matches.

facts.text: ResolveCompileSubject raises subject_not_found when the subject string resolves to no id.
ResolveCompileSubject deserializes the subject pin from the pin column of the subjects row.
BuildDossier leaves Dropped empty for index depth or complete mode and otherwise lists the ids of ranked facts that were not emitted.
BuildDossier fills SelfCheck with the count of facts that lack cites and the number of conflicts, and leaves Linked empty.
at: UncitedClaims = facts.Count(f => f.Cites is null || f.Cites.Count == 0),

facts.text: BuildDossier does not assign Degraded, so a compiled dossier carries a null Degraded.
BuildDossier maps the emitted candidates through the cached views, so Facts follows the emitted order rather than the ranked order.
RenderMarkdown writes a Highlights section and then an All facts section only when HighlightIndexes returns a non-null set.
When the highlight set is empty RenderMarkdown writes the line None fit the budget.
In the All facts section RenderMarkdown puts the bracketed fact id before the text, while highlight lines put it after.
RenderMarkdown writes a Conflicts section only when the dossier has conflicts, one line per field with raw JSON values and bracketed fact ids.
RenderMarkdown writes a Gaps section only when the dossier has gaps, one line per gap as need then reason.
RenderMarkdown calls OneLine with int.MaxValue, so fact text is whitespace-collapsed but never truncated.
HighlightIndexes measures budget cost with the markdown estimators regardless of the request format.
HighlightIndexes returns null when the dossier has no facts or is not in complete mode.
OneLine collapses every run of whitespace to one space, then cuts text longer than max to max minus three characters and appends three dots.
Tokenize lowercases the value and yields runs of letters and digits, splitting at every other character.
ToDossierView takes the section from the first section tag with a non-empty suffix and falls back to the fact kind.
ToDossierView puts the fact's own id first in Cites and appends every id collapsed into it.
The private constant IndexTokenCap bounds index-depth fact content at 300 tokens.
The private constant IndexMaxFacts caps an index-depth dossier at 8 facts.
The private constant IndexMinFacts keeps at least 3 facts in an index-depth dossier even when they exceed the cap.
The private constant IndexLineLength truncates each index-depth fact line at 120 characters.
The private constant MaxDescendantDepth limits a descendants compile to 3 levels below the subject.
The private constant DedupeThreshold sets the near-duplicate Jaccard similarity at 0.85.
The private constant DedupeMinTokens excludes facts with fewer than 4 distinct tokens from clustering.
For markdown, EstimateFactTokens measures the whole line it will emit: dash, one-lined text, bracketed id, status note and newline.
StatusNote returns the empty string unless the fact is stale or contested and carries at least one Why reason.
StatusNote renders a refutes reason as refuted by the fact id that refutes it.
StatusNote renders a derived_from reason with state superseded as the fact id followed by was superseded by the replacing id.
StatusNote writes any ref relation other than derived_from and refutes as contradicts followed by the fact id.
StatusNote joins several reasons with a semicolon and a space inside one pair of parentheses after the status name.
For json, EstimateIndexFactTokens charges only the fact text, not the serialized envelope or per-fact scaffolding.
A Candidate starts with Derived set to StatusLive while Status keeps the stored lifecycle value that dedupe and conflict checks read.
A CompiledDossier starts with Depth set to index and BudgetMode set to complete.
For markdown EstimateRenderedTokens measures the whole RenderMarkdown string, and for json it measures the serialized dossier.
ResolveBudgetMode raises DossierRequestException with code invalid_budget_mode for any value other than complete or strict.
OmitStatusNotes is internal and marked JsonIgnore, so a request body can never set it and only publish uses it.
Jaccard returns 0 when the union of the two token sets is empty.
For markdown EstimateConflictTokens measures the field, every raw value with its bracketed fact id joined by semicolons, and a newline.
